body:
# Infinite Card

Infinite Card is a Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric mod that turns card combat into an in-world board game. Instead of playing through a traditional card-game screen, players interact with a physical battlefield in Minecraft: drawing cards, placing card items onto lanes, sacrificing creatures, resolving attacks, and fighting themed enemies and bosses.

The current main mode is a roguelike PvE run. Players build and improve a deck over multiple encounters, choose routes, trigger events, receive rewards, and face battles with different enemy themes and modifiers.

## Features

- In-world card battle system built inside Minecraft
- Lane-based creature combat
- Creature cards, item cards, sigils, tribes, and themed decks
- Roguelike PvE run flow with battles, events, rewards, shops, and bosses
- Boss encounters inspired by Minecraft enemies
- Configurable card data and balance-focused simulation tools
- Chinese language support by default, with English support included

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Required on both client and server

## Current Status

Infinite Card is currently in beta. The core battle loop, run structure, card pool, events, bosses, codex, music, and configuration systems are implemented, but balance and content are still being actively improved.

Some features may change between versions as the mod continues to develop.

## License

Infinite Card uses a custom proprietary license. You may play the mod, use it on servers, showcase gameplay, and include unmodified official releases in modpacks, but modified public redistributions and asset reuse require permission.
